summary: Enhance your skills with our Introduction to Data Management Training Course. Learn essential techniques for effective data handling and management today!
lede: Data management training gives data stewards, analysts, and governance professionals a practical foundation for improving how organizational data is managed and used. It covers profiling records, assessing quality, assigning ownership, and documenting metadata and data lineage. Through SQL and spreadsheet exercises, participants practice investigating data issues and developing governance controls and improvement roadmaps for more dependable reporting.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who manage, analyze, govern, protect, or report organizational data and need a practical foundation in data management methods.
modules: Master Data and Reference Data Management
Privacy, Security, and Automated Data Controls
prerequisites: No formal certification or programming experience is required. You should have practical exposure to spreadsheets, business reports, databases, or information-handling processes. The course uses guided SQL examples and prepared datasets, so you can complete the exercises without writing production code.
